title: MTD Evidence Pack
user: A UK sole trader using local bookkeeping who needs a quarter-by-quarter evidence pack and a clear readiness checklist before handing data to compatible filing software or an accountant.
smallest_useful_product: Local PWA that imports categorized CSV transactions, checks completeness against a user-maintained period checklist, and exports a read-only ZIP/CSV/PDF handoff.
summary: Prepare a quarterly MTD evidence pack from local bookkeeping records.
